paragraphs: T2 Systems sells parking management software covering permits, enforcement, PARCS, pay stations, and mobile payments. Named solutions include T2 Flex Permit Management and Enforcement, the UPsafety PE solution by T2, T2 PARCS, and pay stations powered by T2 Iris. T2 Citation Services is offered as a collection administration solution.

Their pages list the industries served: universities and colleges, municipalities, private operators, corporate campuses, hospitals and healthcare systems, and airports. Customers range from large university campuses and municipalities to smaller destination towns, as well as private operators and healthcare facilities. Testimonials name Upper Darby Township, PA, and Allentown Parking Authority.

T2 Systems was founded in 1994. In 2021, T2 Systems was acquired by Verra Mobility. The company is described as the largest parking, mobility, and transportation provider in North America, with more than 25 years in the parking management industry.

quote.text: T2’s end-to-end parking management solutions bring together the tools you need to keep your operations running smoothly.
